viewport.note: Chrome window 1920x1080; screenshots returned downscaled to 1568x661.

image_artifacts.reason: The browser control channel did not persist full-resolution screenshots. Only one 754x355 thumbnail was written, which is below OCR fixture quality. No image entered datasets/ or var/captures/ for this batch.
image_artifacts.consequence: This batch is a field-schema observation record only. It must not be used as a vision training, validation, or regression baseline, and it does not change docs/ui-version-matrix.md.

notes: Read-only navigation: home -> mail -> 报告 -> report detail -> 战斗详情 -> 战斗回放. No mail deleted, no reward claimed, no fleet dispatched. Opening reports marked them read, which the user authorised.

layout.title: 邮箱
layout.secondary_tab_behaviour: Unread-count badges that scroll the list to top; they do NOT filter the list. A parser must not assume the secondary tab selects a report subtype.

screens.safety_note: 攻击报告 (player/bot attack report) is the only subject that carries a bot target. 海盗攻击报告 is a pirate battle and must not be matched to a bot dispatch.

parser_landmarks: 发件人: / 主题: header pair with a right-aligned timestamp
战报 section banner above the VS block
VS block: player name, planet name, [galaxy:star:planet] per side
战斗详情 section banner; 查看战斗回放 button is the replay entry point
生成卫星概率 is present on attack reports and absent on pirate reports
differences_from_pirate_report: subject 攻击报告 vs 海盗攻击报告
defender player name is the bot account name, not the literal 'Pirates'
生成卫星概率 row is present

parser_landmarks: 参战战舰 banner introduces the full pre-battle composition; this is the fleet snapshot to persist
第N回合【剩余战舰】 banners repeat per round with per-side remaining counts
Per-round stat cards: 射击次数 / 护盾吸收 / 装甲损伤 / 击杀数 / 引爆数
The defender list mixes ships and ground defences (离子炮, 火箭发射器, 轻型激光炮, MK2 加农炮, 等离子炮); the snapshot schema must keep them distinguishable
A zero count is rendered explicitly as 0 and must not be treated as a missing row

layout.description: Between opening a report and content render, the panel shows only the decorative background text (COMMAND OFFICERS / TOTAL CREWS / -17003 / personnel) with no report fields.
layout.safety_rule: This state is indistinguishable from an empty report by field presence alone. The parser must fail closed and re-observe rather than record an empty report.

layout.description: The 邮箱 frame renders before the tab strip and rows. Tabs and rows appear ~4s later.
layout.safety_rule: Absence of rows is not an empty mailbox until the tab strip is present.

interaction_notes: Panels do not respond to mouse-wheel scroll; the wheel moves the page/parallax instead. Panel content scrolls only via click-drag inside the panel.
Resizing the browser window does not re-layout the game canvas; a reload is required, which drops the open panel and returns to the entry screen.
After scrolling a panel the page itself can shift so the panel header (back button) leaves the viewport; scroll the page up before clicking back.
